subject: Demo follow-up: pilot playbook, success metrics, and risks (Cascade Health)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@cascadehealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo follow-up: pilot playbook, success metrics, and risks (Cascade Health)

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for taking time this morning to walk through the demo and current use cases for clinical summarization and discharge note generation. Per our call, I’m sending a concise pilot playbook so your team has a clear view of scope, success criteria, timeline, and owner responsibilities. I attached a one-tab evaluation workbook (cascade_evaluation_plan_v1.xlsx) and a short pdf with proposed owners/timeline.

Summary (1-minute):
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for discharge summary generation across three pilot sites (ED, Inpatient, Observation).
- Duration: 6 weeks active evaluation + 2 weeks stabilization.
- Key success criteria (pass/fail):
  • Achieve P0 latency for tokenized responses <= 1.2s median for 512 token sequences under representative load.
  • Accuracy: clinical note ROUGE-L >= 0.72 vs. clinician-reviewed gold set (sample N=150).
  • Safety: PHI redaction and access controls demonstrated, no PHI exfiltration incidents in synthetic and farmed tests.
  • Cost target: < $0.035 per generated note at pilot throughput.

Scope & deliverables:
- Redwood delivers model endpoint (dedicated capacity) + KV prefix caching enabled for templates, integration guide, and evaluation harness.
- Cascade provides 3 canonical templates, 150 de-identified seed docs for eval, and an infra contact.

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (kickoff): confirm SOW, data access, and NDA signatures.
- Week 1: infra onboarding + staging endpoint; baseline runs with synthetic data.
- Weeks 2–5: paired runs with clinician review and metric collection.
- Week 6: results review, decision meeting (go/no-go).

Owners:
- Cascade: Avery Collins (project lead), Miguel Santos (technical approval), procurement@cascadehealth.org (contract lead).
- Redwood: Jonas Weber (AE/owner), Rishi Malhotra (solutions architect), Lauren Bishop (CSM).

Known risks & mitigations:
- PHI handling: propose private deployment option or dedicated capacity with KMS + audit logs. We’ve listed required artifacts in the attached workbook.
- Integration friction: propose a canary route for 10% of traffic initially, ramp to 100% after one week of stability.

Next steps I need from you this week:
1) Confirm stakeholders and procurement contact for SOW.
2) Share 150 de-identified seed docs or confirm timing for de-identification.
3) Preferred kickoff window (we proposed Dec 7–10).

If that looks right I’ll draft the SOW and loop procurement/legal. Happy to jump on a quick 15-min sync to finalize owners.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: cascade_evaluation_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 tab)
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@cascadehealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@cascadehealth.org>, procurement@cascadehealth.org
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: pilot playbook, success metrics, and risks (Cascade Health)

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear plan. Two quick clarifying questions before we confirm kickoff:  
1) PHI: we need to understand whether the pilot can run in a way that never sends raw PHI to an external multi-tenant environment. Is dedicated capacity with customer-managed keys sufficient? What evidence or logs do you provide?
2) Clinician review: for the ROUGE-L scoring, can Redwood run the scoring pipeline or do we need to run it locally? We prefer you to run the scoring but provide reproducible code.

Procurement: we will need a preliminary SOW and any standard terms to review.

We can tentatively hold Dec 8 for kickoff. Miguel — including you here for tech sign-off on the PHI approach.

Thanks,
Avery
Director of Clinical Innovation
Cascade Health
avery.collins@cascadehealth.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@cascadehealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@cascadehealth.org
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: pilot playbook, success metrics, and risks (Cascade Health)

Avery —

Great questions. Short answers up front: yes — dedicated capacity + customer KMS meets your PHI constraint, and we provide audit logs + per-request tracing for the pilot. We also support deploying the Redwood private control plane inside your VPC if you prefer zero external egress.

Details:
- PHI options (ascending isolation):
  1) Hosted dedicated (Redwood-managed hardware) with customer-managed KMS and request-level audit logs (fastest time-to-value).
  2) Dedicated in your cloud account (Redwood-managed images, customer VPC peering) — recommended for regulated PHI workloads.
  3) Private on-prem package (air-gapped) — available but adds lead time.

- Evidence & logs: we supply an audit bundle each day (request IDs, timestamps, model variant, token counts) and can provide a one-time signed attestation for the pilot. We will also enable structured logs to your SIEM via secure forwarding.

- Scoring pipeline: Redwood can run the scoring pipeline on our side against the de-identified gold set and provide the reproducible code and a Dockerfile. If you need the scoring to run inside your environment for compliance, we can provide the same pipeline as a package you run locally.

I attached our recommended infra diagram (recommended_infra_diagram.png) showing the dedicated capacity option with KMS and log forwarding.

Next steps from Redwood (on our side):
- Draft SOW and standard pilot terms (will share by EOD Mon).
- Rishi to spool up a staging endpoint and share onboarding checklist.
- Lauren to confirm CSM coverage and success metric dashboards.

We still propose Dec 8 kickoff; please confirm stakeholder list and any legal must-haves we should include in the SOW.

Jonas

Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: pilot playbook, success metrics, and risks (Cascade Health)

Hi Avery — quick note from the CS perspective.

Thanks for flagging the PHI question — we’ll default to the dedicated-in-your-account option for this pilot (best tradeoff between isolation and speed). A few operational clarifications so the kickoff is productive:

1) Redwood staffing we’ll assign for the pilot: Lauren Bishop (CSM, onboarding & success), Rishi Malhotra (SA, infra & tuning), plus one inference engineer (on-call for model tuning).
2) Canary plan: start at 10% traffic for 48–72 hours, collect latency/quality metrics, then 50% for 3 days before full ramp.
3) Success metric dashboard: we’ll provide a shared Looker/retention dashboard and daily summary exports.
4) Data flow: for the staging run, please send the de-identified gold set to secure S3 bucket (instructions in attached pdf). If you cannot de-id within the timeframe we can run with synthetic data and a smaller clinician-reviewed sample.

We’ll produce an updated roles/timeline pdf and proposed SOW by EOD (attached: redwood_poc_roles_and_timeline.pdf). If Dec 8 works, I’ll book a 30-min kickoff and include Rishi and the inference engineer.

—Lauren
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Jonas / Avery —

Thanks for the plan and the clarifications. Dec 8 works for a kickoff with our infra and compliance leads. Two items on procurement/legal:  
1) We need an initial SOW with clear acceptance criteria and trial terms (length, termination, liability cap, data handling).
2) I’ve attached our procurement checklist (procurement_checklist.pdf) — please confirm you can provide the audit bundle and the Dockerized scoring pipeline as described.

If Redwood can deliver the SOW by EOD Monday and confirm the dedicated-in-account option, we’ll proceed and schedule the kickoff invite.

Miguel Santos
CTO, Cascade Health
miguel.santos@cascadehealth.org
